bullets.title: COHR Q4 FY26 Blowout: Revenue $2.05B +34% YoY, Raises Q1 Guide
bullets.body: Coherent reported Q4 revenue of $2.05B (+34% YoY, +13% QoQ), non-GAAP gross margin of 40.2%, and EPS of $1.74 vs. $1.58 consensus—data center/comms now 79% of revenue. Q1 revenue guidance raised to $2.2B–$2.4B (midpoint $2.3B, vs. consensus $2.15B), with EPS guide of $1.85–$2.05. One observer noted FY27 growth should accelerate vs. FY26.

bullets.title: CSCO Q4 FY26 Strong Beat; Q1 Revenue Guide $18.0–18.2B vs. $16.84B Consensus
bullets.body: Cisco posted Q4 revenue of $17.3B (+18% YoY), non-GAAP EPS of $1.22 (+23% YoY), and product revenue +24%. Q1 guidance of $18.0–18.2B is a massive beat vs. the $16.84B consensus; EPS guide $1.32–1.34 vs. $1.17 estimate. Full-year 2027 adj. EPS guided $5.05–5.11 vs. $4.84 estimate.

bullets.title: Coherent Moving Up Stack into OCS/Full Systems — Competitive Threat to CIEN, CSCO
bullets.body: Coherent's expansion into optical coherent subsystems and full networking systems creates a new competitive dynamic against incumbent OEMs Ciena and Cisco, per post-earnings read-through analysis. Optics demand characterized as 'lumpy' with scale not yet achieved.

bullets.title: Burry Doubles Down on NBIS Short; Also Adds MU, ORCL Shorts and SOXX Puts
bullets.body: Michael Burry doubled his short in Nebius (NBIS) and added new short positions in Micron (MU) and Oracle (ORCL), plus put options on the SOXX semiconductor ETF, per 13F disclosures. This comes the same day NBIS surged 34% for its 2nd-best day in company history.

bullets.title: NBIS Surges 34% on AI Earnings Wave; Bears Covering
bullets.body: Nebius soared 34% for its second-best day ever, with fintwit noting strong AI earnings from NBIS and LITE pushing bears into hibernation. Burry's disclosed short against the move adds a notable contrary signal.

bullets.title: COHR Earnings Signal Broadening AI Infrastructure Spend Beyond Accelerators
bullets.body: Coherent's Q4 call described as 'supplier-level validation' that AI spending is shifting from concentrated accelerator procurement to sustained, multi-layer infrastructure investment across the stack, according to fintwit analysis.

bullets.title: SNDK Investor Day Tomorrow 9am ET; MSCI ACWI Addition Could Drive Flows
bullets.body: SanDisk hosts Investor Day tomorrow at 9am ET; previews expect new long-term agreements (NBMs) that could set the tone for broader memory sector names. Separately, SNDK is among the largest additions to the MSCI ACWI index in the latest rebalancing, triggering index-fund flow.

bullets.title: CART Also Added to MSCI ACWI — Index Rebalancing Flow Incoming
bullets.body: Carpenter Technology (CART) is among the three largest additions by full market cap in the MSCI ACWI rebalancing alongside SNDK, with 55 total additions and 92 deletions expected to trigger index-fund rebalancing flows.

bullets.title: HOOD July Metrics Strong: AUM +19% YoY, Equity Volume +59%, Options +66%
bullets.body: Robinhood reported July 2026 monthly metrics: 28.5M funded customers (+1.77M YoY), $355B platform AUM (+19% YoY), $5.6B net deposits (18% annualized growth), equity notional volume $333B (+59% YoY), and options contracts 324M (+66% YoY).

bullets.title: GEV: NextEra + U.S. Commerce + Japan Govt Finalize 10 GW Gas Project
bullets.body: GE Vernova reached a commercial funding milestone with the U.S. Department of Commerce and the Government of Japan for a project funding up to 10 GW of gas-powered generation capacity, per tweet citing Bloomberg.

bullets.title: Intel 14A Node Seeing Strong Customer Demand Amid Constrained Alternatives
bullets.body: A supply-chain analyst noted Intel's 14A node is attracting significant customer orders partly due to lack of alternative capacity elsewhere, with performance improvements over prior Intel nodes cited as an additional draw.

bullets.title: Broad AI Bull Case: Vishria Says 'It All Works' — CSPs, Neoclouds, NVDA, Chip Startups
bullets.body: Eric Vishria articulated a comprehensive AI bull case: CSPs, neoclouds, NVIDIA, chip startups, and large data-center models all succeed. CoreWeave's quarterly results showing sustained compute demand were cited as supporting this thesis across the sector.

bullets.title: AAPL: New Siri Impresses; Supplier Signals Pro iPhone Launch This Fall
bullets.body: A fintwit user described new Siri as handling more use cases than expected, automating tasks across apps, but flagged Apple has a 'perception issue' despite strong product capability. Separately, a supplier earnings call supports rumors of a high-end Pro series iPhone launch this fall.

bullets.title: AMD Highlights Agentic AI Shifting Compute Infrastructure Requirements
bullets.body: AMD's official account flagged that agentic AI is changing compute requirements behind AI infrastructure, with an AMD executive discussing the implications—a read-through for the broader compute ecosystem.

bullets.title: VIX Hits Year-Low; SPY Tracking Lowest Weekly Volume Since Feb 2025
bullets.body: CBOE VIX fell to its lowest level of the year, while SPY is on track for its lowest weekly volume since February 2025—both suggesting reduced near-term fear but also flagging a low-participation rally. Goldman strategist Pasquariello cited 'path of least resistance higher' but with caveats.

bullets.title: Market Rally Supported by $1T+ Buybacks, Systematic Rebalancing, Retail Return
bullets.body: Fintwit notes the S&P 500 +0.27% close was driven by $1T+ corporate buybacks, systematic rebalancing flows, and retail returning to the market; bond and stock bids followed tame July CPI with markets pricing 62% odds of a September Fed rate hold. Bonds rallied on fiscal/supply concerns, not inflation.

bullets.title: U.S. July Budget Deficit $432B — Largest July Deficit on Record, $86B Above Estimate
bullets.body: The July federal deficit came in at $432.31B vs. $346B consensus estimate, up 48% vs. July prior year ($291B), driven by Medicare, Social Security, and net interest costs. Interest on U.S. public debt is now tracking $1.37T over the trailing 12 months, on pace to exceed Social Security as the largest budget line.

bullets.title: Memory Wall Emerging as AI's Primary Bottleneck — Photonic Fabrics as Solution
bullets.body: Multiple photonics-focused voices flagged that the 'memory wall'—data movement rather than raw compute—is becoming the key AI architecture constraint. Photonic fabrics and large-scale memory pooling are cited as potential architectural solutions, with upcoming conference discussion anticipated.

bullets.title: SNOW Hits 52-Week High; JPM Sets New All-Time High
bullets.body: Snowflake reached a 52-week high during Wednesday's session. JPMorgan also set a new all-time high, with market breadth supported by CPI-driven relief and buyback flows.

bullets.title: DeepSeek v4 Pro Outperforms NVIDIA Nemotron on Agentic Tasks at Far Lower Parameter Count
bullets.body: DeepSeek's v4 Pro 0813 1.5T model is reported to beat Nvidia's Nemotron3 Ultra on agentic benchmarks, while the smaller DeepSeek Flash variant beats Nemotron with 4.2x fewer active parameters—a potential efficiency pressure on high-compute AI infrastructure spending.
